=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1625-1629 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The Install OpenCode CLI step has `continue-on-error: true` even though OpenCode is now a hard runtime dependency.
  WHY: Installation failures are hidden until the later preflight reports a generic missing-binary error after expensive setup; moonshotai_kimi-k3 rated this NIT while the other reviewers rated it MAJOR.

- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:32-40 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The script silently skips sourcing `opencode_helpers.sh` when it is missing instead of failing fast like the companion OpenCode scripts.
  WHY: Reviewer execution later produces cryptic `command not found` failures rather than a structured missing-helper diagnostic; moonshotai_kimi-k3 rated this NIT while the other reviewers rated it MAJOR.

- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4800-4802 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The resolver reasoning-effort comment contains a duplicated “the legacy” fragment.
  WHY: The malformed comment does not affect execution but makes the resolver reasoning contract unclear.

- scripts/write_opencode_config.sh:153-185 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The reviewer-role OpenCode configuration denies edit/write/patch tools but allows unrestricted bash, leaving reviewers, judges, and the summariser able to mutate the checkout through shell commands.
  WHY: Bash redirection can write files that `review_commit_changes.sh` later stages into the autofix commit, contradicting the declared isolated read-only boundary.

- scripts/summarize_reviewer_consensus.sh:68-75 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The OpenCode config writer path is invoked without an existence preflight.
  WHY: A missing or mis-staged writer is reported as `config_generation` rather than a distinct `config_writer_missing` failure, and the same gap exists in companion scripts; moonshotai_kimi-k3 and qwen_qwen3_7-plus rated this NIT while minimax_minimax-m3 rated it MAJOR.

- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:197 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: Including `|^Changes made:` in `editor_output_has_apply_patch` matches every standards-compliant editor response, including no-op responses.
  WHY: `editor_silent_rounds` is reset after every attempt, permanently defeating the escalating anti-stall nag.

- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3905-3921 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: The interim judge and behavioural smoke stages still hard-require the removed Codex binary.
  WHY: Opting into `JUDGE_INTERIM_ENABLED=true` or `BEHAVIOURAL_SMOKE_FROM_JUDGE_ENABLED=true` makes both stages fail or become permanent no-ops with `missing_codex`.

- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:14-17 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The consolidator soft-checks `opencode_helpers.sh` and continues when the required helper file is missing.
  WHY: It later emits a cryptic `command not found` instead of a structured missing-helper failure.

- agents.md:203-206 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `agents.md` still says OpenCode is operationally inert and that review/autofix remains Codex-backed.
  WHY: The architecture reference contradicts the shipped OpenCode cutover and can cause future agents and operators to restore obsolete Codex assumptions.

- changelog.d/3849-opencode-read-side.md:2 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The read-side changelog fragment still says Codex powers the editor, judge, consolidator, and conflict-resolution stages.
  WHY: It contradicts `changelog.d/3865-opencode-write-side.md`, causing the assembled changelog to make conflicting claims about the production review path.

- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1584-1597 and scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:1595-1610 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `CODEX_THREAD_REUSE_ENABLED` handler was replaced with a no-op that always uses the fresh full-prompt path.
  WHY: Consumers setting the documented variable no longer receive thread reuse, while the accepted environment variable continues to imply that the feature is enabled.

- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:229-233 and 3083-3094 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `REVIEW_PREFLIGHT_REQUIRED_SUPPORT_SCRIPTS` lists the OpenCode helpers, but the preflight only verifies the binary and does not verify those support scripts.
  WHY: Missing support files are allowed through to deep reviewer/editor/summariser/resolver failures instead of being rejected with an upstream diagnostic.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The PR migrates review_autofix editor, reviewers, summariser, consolidator, judge, and conflict resolver through OpenCode, replacing the Codex CLI installation and shared config mutation; `agents.md` should reflect that review/autofix is now OpenCode-backed.
  expected_change_site: agents.md lines 203-206 ("OpenCode Phase 1 is operationally inert ... All production phases, including review/autofix, remain Codex-backed") and the model table.
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  EVIDENCE: `agents.md` is not in the PR changed files list and still claims “OpenCode Phase 1 is operationally inert” and “All production phases, including review/autofix, remain Codex-backed”.

- requirement: The PR introduces a long-running supervisor candidate and removes the install-codex action from the active workflow; the required removal registry should document the obsolete install-codex action and/or new install-opencode action.
  expected_change_site: docs/scripts-pending-removal.md
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The PR diff contains no `docs/scripts-pending-removal.md` entry for retiring the `install-codex` composite action or for the new `install-opencode` action.

- requirement: README’s Variables table should document the OpenCode version and a reviewer scratch-directory override such as `OPENCODE_REVIEWER_TMPDIR`.
  expected_change_site: README.md Variables table
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: README’s Variables section is unchanged, while `OPENCODE_VERSION` was added to the workflow and reviewer scratch space defaults to `${RUNNER_TEMP:-${HOME}/.cache}/opencode_reviewers`.

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1625-1629 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The Install OpenCode CLI step has continue-on-error: true.
  WHY: A failed OpenCode install wastes minutes of runner time and buries the real failure cause behind a secondary missing-binary error.

- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:37-40 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The script soft-checks whether opencode_helpers.sh exists and silently continues when it is missing.
  WHY: Reviewer attempt paths call functions provided by opencode_helpers.sh, which then fail with "command not found" instead of a clear fatal diagnostic.

- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4800-4802 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The comment block on the resolver step's CONFLICT_RESOLVER_REASONING_EFFORT env carries a doubled fragment.
  WHY: The garbled sentence is confusing to operators reading the workflow source, although it does not cause a runtime failure.

- Requirement: The PR migrates review_autofix editor, reviewers, summariser, consolidator, judge, and conflict resolver through OpenCode, replacing the Codex CLI installation and shared config mutation. agents.md should reflect that review/autofix is now OpenCode-backed.
  Expected change site: agents.md lines 203-206 ("OpenCode Phase 1 is operationally inert ... All production phases, including review/autofix, remain Codex-backed") and the model table.
  Evidence of absence: agents.md is not in the PR changed files list. The file still claims "OpenCode Phase 1 is operationally inert" and "All production phases, including review/autofix, remain Codex-backed — until a later cutover phase lands after the all-slug live smoke succeeds."
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/write_opencode_config.sh:158 (referenced by tests/test_summarize_reviewer_consensus_sandbox_pin.py:51-58 and scripts/summarize_reviewer_consensus.sh:251-256) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The reviewer-role OpenCode profile allows bash while denying edit/write/patch/apply_patch, so a reviewer can mutate the checkout via shell commands.
  WHY: On consumer repos, review_commit_changes.sh stages whatever landed with git add -u, contradicting the declared isolated-read-only boundary.

  PROBLEM: The Install OpenCode CLI step uses `continue-on-error: true`.
  WHY: Installation failures are swallowed and surface later as a generic missing-binary error after expensive setup.

- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:32-40 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new soft-source block silently skips sourcing opencode_helpers.sh when it is missing.
  WHY: Every reviewer slot then reports cryptic command-not-found errors instead of one attributable fatal alert.

- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:32-40 and scripts/summarize_reviewer_consensus.sh:65-79 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Neither script preflight-checks the existence of write_opencode_config.sh before invoking it.
  WHY: A missing writer is reported as config_generation rather than config_writer_missing.

- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4800-4802 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The resolver comment contains a doubled "the legacy" phrase.
  WHY: It makes the documented reasoning contract garbled but does not break execution.

- agents.md:203-206 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: agents.md still claims all production phases are Codex-backed.
  WHY: The document contradicts the OpenCode production cutover and misleads future agents and operators.

- changelog.d/3849-opencode-read-side.md:2 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The read-side fragment says Codex remains installed and powers the editor, judge, consolidator, and conflict-resolution stages.
  WHY: It contradicts the current write-side cutover fragment and misinforms operators.

- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1584-1597 and scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:1595-1610 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The CODEX_THREAD_REUSE_ENABLED handler is now a no-op.
  WHY: Consumers still setting the documented variable receive the fresh full-prompt path without the documented continuation behavior.

- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:229-233 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The required-support list names the OpenCode helpers, but preflight only verifies the opencode binary.
  WHY: Missing support scripts are discovered deep in the fan-out and misclassified by downstream alerts.
